entity_types: ONGs (associações, fundações, instituições sem fins lucrativos) under Lei 8/2012 (DAN05-IIS, 28-05-2012): Art. 2 definition; Art. 3.1 constitution by escritura pública (notarial deed); Art. 9 registration at DGRN Registo Nacional das ONGs by despacho do Ministro da Justiça (15 days)
cost_time: Fees: unpublished (no official fee schedule; notarial deed + registration costs vary; ONGIPs exempt per Art. 30). Time: 15-day decision (Art. 9.5) + 15-day certificate (Art. 9.6) statutory; 2-6 months practical (registry needs ≥2 yrs activity, ≥10 members, Art. 9.2)
